gp.bio: Poole is the elderly butler of Dr. Jekyll's house and the servant who directs the search after the cabinet is broken open. gp.bio: Dr. Henry Jekyll is a fifty-year-old doctor, owner of the house with laboratory and cabinet, and the friend and client of Mr. Utterson. He is tall and well built, known for charities and religion, but has become fanciful and estranged from Dr. Lanyon. His will left all his possessions to Edward Hyde, and he admitted Hyde dictated its terms. He swore he would never set eyes on Hyde again, then resumed his old friendships before shutting his door against Utterson and vowing extreme seclusion. He was last seen sitting sadly at the middle window, declining to walk out. He is said to have been made away with eight days ago, and his body has not been found.

He has a key to Jekyll's house, comes by the dissecting room door, and all servants are ordered to obey him. He now mostly uses the laboratory and never dines there.
